description: Directly update an existing test case's fields. Pass only the fields you want to change — others are left untouched. Anything the test must or must not touch, including which target and which path, goes in the test case's stored description before the run. A limit stated only in chat with the coding agent does not reach the run. Use this for cheap, deterministic edits (rename, change status/priority, fix expected result, add tags, set or clear the pinned account with pinnedAccount, set whether every run starts from a fresh session with alwaysStartsFreshSession; pinned account and fresh session apply from the next script generation, not to existing scripts; set the roles it acts as and its prerequisite and result test states with actsAsRoleIds, prerequisiteStateId and resultStateId, null clearing each). A status change follows the test case lifecycle and is written after the other fields: a status the lifecycle does not reach from the current one fails the call with the statuses it does reach, and the other fields stay saved. Does not touch the associated test script — script regeneration is a separate workflow (muggle-remote-workflow-start-test-script-generation).

actsAsRoleIds.description: Test role IDs (UUID) the test acts as, in order; null clears them

alwaysStartsFreshSession.description: True when the test must begin in a brand-new browser session with nothing signed in: its precondition needs a signed-out visitor, a brand-new account, or the first registration or sign-in of an account. False when it continues in a state an earlier test established, such as already being signed in or data an earlier test created.

automated.description: Whether this test case is automated

description.description: Updated description; keep the stored text and add to it. Anything the test must or must not touch, including which target and which path, goes in the test case's stored description before the run. A limit stated only in chat with the coding agent does not reach the run.

emailSecretId.description: Secret ID (UUID) of the secret holding the account email

passwordSecretId.description: Secret ID (UUID) of the secret holding the account password

pinnedAccount.description: Project secrets the test case signs in as; null clears the pin

prerequisiteStateId.description: Test state ID (UUID) the test needs to start; null clears it

resultStateId.description: Test state ID (UUID) the test leaves when it passes; the prerequisite's ID for an observation; null clears it

status.description: New lifecycle status; a status the lifecycle does not reach from the current one fails the call

name: muggle-remote-test-case-update
